name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The '28' is the dispatch index (idx 0x28 of the per-event handler table at 0x51B91), a legitimate domain ID, NOT an address residue (function address is 0x34FCB, unrelated to 0x28). Confirmed via xref: dispatch table slot at 0x51c31 holds pointer cb4f0300 = 0x34FCB, next slot = 0x34FF0 (idx 0x29). 'ch17' + 'dialog_with_state' accurately reflect the chapter-17 turn-4 dialog beat with preceding state mutations (portrait reload + camera pan) before the dialog.
purpose: Chapter-17 turn-4 (phase 1) event handler (dispatch idx 0x28): reload portrait set 2, pan camera to (0x11,0x25), then show chapter dialog page 1.
logic_summary: Straight-line, single-basic-block, no branch/RNG/numeric-compute. Compiler-injected __CHK(0x28) stack probe, then fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(2), fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0x11,0x25), and a page-1 fd2_display_dialog_scene call with the group's fixed dialog geometry (0xA0000 VGA base, 0x140 stride, 0xCD/0x4C window XY, 0x4A style, 0x13 max lines, 1 wait flag). In the original binary the handler runs its own portrait+pan prefix then JMPs (0x34FEB -> 0x34BF6) into the +0x0F shared entry of fd2_show_chapter_dialog_with_portrait_set_1 @ 0x34BE7, reusing its 8-PUSH+text-push+CALL display_dialog+RET tail while skipping that body's own portrait-set-1 reload (set 2 already loaded). Src reproduces that borrowed page-1 dialog as an inline call for Layer-2 equivalence. Never reads event_arg.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform event argument passed by the per-event dispatch table at 0x51B91 (1-arg cdecl ABI shared by all handlers; stepping-char-id / event slot). This handler ignores it (cast to void).

returns.semantics: No return value; no CALL-return value consumed.
